name: 18909-chatdecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target) + yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B (draft). The target repo is the ungated mirror of `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` -- same weights; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, draft TP=1. One V1 engine on one card.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03e9 params (16.1 GB). Draft: the EAGLE-3 head published for this target, one hidden layer, ~1.5 GB, max_position_embeddings 2048 -- which is what caps max-model-len.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 400 requests with a 5400 s safety cap, first 20% discarded as warmup.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: `configs/data/mtbench-firstturn-80x5.jsonl` -- the FIRST TURN of all 80 MT-Bench questions (question_id 81-160), cycled 5 times to make the 400-request bound. `request_format: default-template` applies the model's chat template, so the wire prompt is 75.7 tokens mean and 359 max. Output capped at 256 tokens per request, EOS honoured (`ignore_eos: false`), greedy (`temperature: 0.0`).
purpose: A single-user chat assistant answering short open-ended questions with an 8B model and draft-model speculation on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# `"method": "eagle3"` IS NOT A RESTATED DEFAULT: speculative-method auto-detection resolves an
# `eagle3-` checkpoint path to method `eagle`, so leaving it unset serves a different implementation.
# KEEP THIS ON ONE LINE. The config reader is line-based and skips indented continuations, so
# re-flowing it into a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts with no speculation.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 4, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1, "max_model_len": 2048}

# The draft checkpoint's own max_position_embeddings; the longest request is 359 + 256 tokens.
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.80
max-num-seqs: 8
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
enforce-eager: true

# Against the V1 default of ON: the 80 prompts repeat 5 times in the request file.
enable-prefix-caching: false
